name: clamav
document:
{"apiVersion": "patchgate.io/v1alpha1", "kind": "Agent", "metadata": {"description": "ClamAV open-source antivirus with signature updates and a daily scan timer.", "name": "clamav"}, "spec": {"install": {"linux": {"method": "package", "packages": {"apt": ["clamav", "clamav-freshclam"], "dnf": ["clamav", "clamav-update"]}, "postInstall": "if [ -f /etc/freshclam.conf ]; then sed -i '/^Example/d' /etc/freshclam.conf; fi
freshclam --quiet || echo "freshclam failed (rate limit?); signatures will update on next run"
install -d -m 0755 /var/log/patchgate
cat > /etc/systemd/system/patchgate-clamscan.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Patchgate daily ClamAV scan
[Service]
Type=oneshot
Nice=19
IOSchedulingClass=idle
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'freshclam --quiet || true; clamscan -r -i --exclude-dir=^/proc --exclude-dir=^/sys --exclude-dir=^/dev /home /tmp /var /opt >> /var/log/patchgate/clamscan.log 2>&1 || true'
UNIT
cat > /etc/systemd/system/patchgate-clamscan.timer <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Run Patchgate ClamAV scan daily
[Timer]
OnCalendar=daily
RandomizedDelaySec=1h
Persistent=true
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now patchgate-clamscan.timer
"}}, "validate": {"linux": "command -v clamscan >/dev/null && systemctl is-enabled --quiet patchgate-clamscan.timer"}}}

name: ssh-disable-empty-passwords
document:
{"apiVersion": "patchgate.io/v1alpha1", "kind": "Control", "metadata": {"description": "SSH empty passwords are not permitted", "name": "ssh-disable-empty-passwords", "references": {"cis": "5.2.11"}}, "spec": {"check": "sshd -T 2>/dev/null | grep -qi '^permitemptypasswords no$'", "level": "cis-level1", "platform": "linux", "remediate": "f=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/01-patchgate-ssh-disable-empty-passwords.conf
# sshd uses the first value it reads: neutralise the directive anywhere else first.
for other in /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf; do
  if [ -f "$other" ] && [ "$other" != "$f" ]; then
    sed -i -E 's/^[[:space:]]*(PermitEmptyPasswords)[[:space:]]+/# disabled by patchgate: \1 /I' "$other"
  fi
done
echo 'PermitEmptyPasswords no' > "$f"
if ! sshd -t; then rm -f "$f"; echo "sshd config invalid; reverted" >&2; exit 1; fi
systemctl reload sshd 2>/dev/null || systemctl reload ssh
"}}

systemctl reload sshd 2>/dev/null || systemctl reload ssh
"}}
